pages.text: Today Coco is making their very own bread for the first time. Coco received a lump of dough.
"I'm going to make a snail." Coco began rolling the dough into a coil.
Grandpa Mole peered at it. "Where is the end?" He pressed down in the wrong place.
Mrs. Magpie landed on the windowsill. "It should be rounder." She shaped it with little pokes.
Mr. Pig helped too. "It should be bigger." He pulled and stretched it.
The dough looked strange. It wasn't a snail. It wasn't anything at all.
Coco received fresh dough. This time Coco turned away and rolled it alone.
The golden bread sat in a row on the display shelf.
A customer pointed to just one. "That snail bread, please."
It was the snail Coco had rolled. The customer took a bite right there. All three grown-ups gulped.
